definitions.gloss: water outage, water cutoff, suspension of water supply
definitions.explanation: The temporary interruption of water supply, whether planned or due to an emergency.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}のため{断水|だんすい}になる。
examples.english: The water will be cut off due to construction work.

examples.japanese: {断水|だんすい}に{備|そな}えて{水|みず}を{貯|た}めた。
examples.english: I stored water in preparation for the water outage.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{断水|だんすい}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The water outage is continuing due to the earthquake.

examples.japanese: {断水|だんすい}のお{知|し}らせが{届|とど}いたので、お{風呂|ふろ}に{水|みず}を{貯|た}めておいた。
examples.english: A notice about the water shutoff arrived, so I filled the bathtub with water.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{三日間|みっかかん}{断水|だんすい}が{続|つづ}き、{給水車|きゅうすいしゃ}が{来|き}て{助|たす}かった。
examples.english: The water outage lasted three days due to the typhoon, and we were saved when the water truck came.

notes:
{断水|だんすい} refers to the interruption of water supply.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {断水|だんすい}になる: water supply is cut off
- {断水|だんすい}{復旧|ふっきゅう}: restoration of water supply
- {計画|けいかく}{断水|だんすい}: planned water shutoff

RELATED WORDS:
- {停電|ていでん}: power outage
- {給水|きゅうすい}: water supply
- {断|だん}ガス: gas cutoff
